title: Personal Thoughts on Teaching and Learning
coreMove: Shift from delivering knowledge at students to arranging conditions where learners take ownership.
sourcePressure: Rogers extends his stance into education by challenging teacher-centered control and asking what makes learning personally alive. No split source sidecar exists for ch13; frozen TOC and book skeleton support the heading, part placement, and broad intent only, with no chapter-local named anecdotes, studies, or places.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Reducing the chapter to progressive classroom warmth or anti-teacher authority.
sourceAnchorNote: The frozen source exposes no usable chapter-local named person, study, institution, place, date, or anecdotal artifact from Rogers here. Use fictional protagonists only; do not invent named Rogers cases or studies.

hook: opening with a definition of teaching
counterintuition: Most people think X, but Y
It is not about being nice
The paradox is that acceptance changes everything

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person direct address, retrospective, question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps
